text: a similar protocol in younger and older men showed that 12 weeks of cycle ergometry produced an increase in Type I fiber cross-sectional area of approximately 20% (38). Type IIa fiber diameter actually decreased in younger subjects, although not significantly, whereas that of the older subjects remained relatively constant. These findings imply that aerobic exercise may have a detrimental effect on hypertrophy of the faster fiber types. However, other studies show beneficial effects of aerobic training on Type II fiber cross-sectional area in both older (13, 19) and younger (4) subjects. The cause of the discrepancies in findings between studies is not clear.
book: Science and Development of Muscle Hypertrophy
